versioningNote: The git tag vX.Y.Z is the version. TODO(stack): list how each part reads it (e.g. MinVer, a version file bumped via versionFiles, build number from CI).
ciTriggerNote: .github/workflows/release.yml triggers on the v* tag push: test (reusable test.yml), then build, then the GitHub release. PRs into dev, main and release/** and pushes to dev run the same test gate (.github/workflows/ci.yml). changes, test / scripts and test / app are required checks on main and dev, so a release PR merges only after they pass: wait for them to finish, then merge; never gh pr merge --auto.
